Eligibility

Eligibility and the two physical tests

Check age, Swedish-language evidence, suitability and the published fitness thresholds before applying.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Age and prescribed training

Applicants must be at least 20, complete the prescribed training and be considered suitable in light of lawfulness and other circumstances.

Swedish and communication

A passing Swedish 1 upper-secondary grade or equivalent is part of the published suitability requirements and supports instruction, communication and reporting.

01ASSIGNMENT02AUTHORITY03PROPORTION04REPORT

Run and dummy drag

The published tests require 2 kilometres in no more than 12 minutes and lifting and dragging a 77-kilogram dummy at least 15 metres, or an equivalent load.

Prepare before test day

Build running volume progressively and practise safe lift-and-drag patterns. The thresholds are selection requirements, not medical advice or an individual training prescription.
